name: bare-https

exports.description: Creates an `HTTPSServer`. If `onrequest` is given, it's added as a `'request'` listener.

params.name: opts
params.description: Server options: TLS socket options (for example `cert`, `key`) plus `bare-http1` server connection options.

exports.name: request
signatures: request(url: URL | string, opts?: HTTPSClientRequestOptions, onresponse?: (res: HTTPIncomingMessage) => void): HTTPSClientRequest

request(opts: HTTPSClientRequestOptions, onresponse?: (res: HTTPIncomingMessage) => void): HTTPSClientRequest
exports.description: Creates an `HTTPSClientRequest` to `url` (a `URL` or a URL string), using TLS. If `onresponse` is given, it's added as a one-time `'response'` listener. Does not send the request until it's ended.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL to request, as a `URL` object or a URL string.

params.name: opts
params.description: `bare-http1` client request options; `agent` defaults to `globalAgent`, or pass `agent: false` to use a fresh `HTTPSAgent`.

exports.name: HTTPSSocketEvents
signatures:
interface HTTPSSocketEvents {
  connect: []
  data: [data: unknown]
  end: []
  readable: []
  piping: [dest: Writable]
  close: []
  error: [err: Error]
  drain: []
  finish: []
  pipe: [src: Readable]
  lookup: [err: Error | null, address: string | null, family: IPFamily | 0, host: string]
  timeout: [ms: number]
}
exports.description: The events an `HTTPSSocket` emits: those of both `TLSSocket` and `TCPSocket`.

exports.name: HTTPSSocketOptions
signatures:
interface HTTPSSocketOptions {
  isServer?: boolean
  cert?: ArrayBufferView
  key?: ArrayBufferView
  host?: string
  rejectUnauthorized?: boolean
  ca?: ArrayBufferView
  alpnProtocols?: string[]
  eagerOpen?: boolean
  allowHalfOpen?: boolean
  readBufferSize?: number
  lookup?: DNSLookup
  keepAlive?: boolean
  keepAliveInitialDelay?: boolean
  noDelay?: boolean
  port?: number
  timeout?: number
  family?: `IPv${IPFamily}` | IPFamily | 0
  hints?: number
  all?: boolean
}
exports.description: Options for `HTTPSSocket`: those of `TLSSocket` combined with `TCPSocket`'s connection options.

exports.name: HTTPSSocket
signatures:
interface HTTPSSocket<M extends HTTPSSocketEvents = HTTPSSocketEvents> {
  readonly socket: Duplex
  readonly encrypted: true
  readonly alpnProtocol: string | null
  _open(cb: StreamCallback): void
  _predestroy(): void
  _destroy(err: Error | null, cb: StreamCallback): void
  readonly readable: boolean
  readonly writable: boolean
  readonly destroyed: boolean
  readonly destroying: boolean
  destroy(err?: Error | null): void
  _read(size: number): void
  readonly closed: boolean
  readonly errored: Error | null
  push(data: unknown | null, encoding?: BufferEncoding): boolean
  unshift(data: unknown | null, encoding?: BufferEncoding): boolean
  read(): unknown | null
  resume(): this
  pause(): this
  pipe<S extends Writable>(dest: S, cb?: StreamCallback): S
  setEncoding(encoding: BufferEncoding): void
  _write(data: unknown, encoding: StreamEncoding, cb: StreamCallback): void
  _writev(batch: { chunk: unknown; encoding: StreamEncoding }[], cb: StreamCallback): void
  _final(cb: StreamCallback): void
  write(data: unknown, encoding?: BufferEncoding, cb?: StreamCallback): boolean
  end(cb?: StreamCallback): this
  cork(): void
  uncork(): void
  readonly connecting: boolean
  readonly pending: boolean
  readonly timeout?: number
  readonly readyState: 'open' | 'opening'
  readonly localAddress?: string
  readonly localFamily?: string
  readonly localPort?: number
  readonly remoteAddress?: string
  readonly remoteFamily?: string
  readonly remotePort?: number
  connect(port: number, host?: string, opts?: TCPSocketConnectOptions, onconnect?: () => void): this
  open(fd: number, opts?: { fd?: number }, onconnect?: () => void): this
  setKeepAlive(enable?: boolean, delay?: number): this
  setNoDelay(enable?: boolean): this
  setTimeout(ms: number, ontimeout?: () => void): this
  ref(): this
  unref(): this
}
exports.description: A `TCPSocket` wrapped in TLS, extending both `TLSSocket` and `TCPSocket`. Used as the transport for HTTPS requests and responses.

exports.name: globalAgent
exports.description: The default `HTTPSAgent` used by `request()` when no `agent` option is given.

exports.name: HTTPSAgent
signatures:
interface HTTPSAgent {
  createConnection(opts?: HTTPSSocketOptions): HTTPSSocket
  readonly suspended: boolean
  readonly resumed: Promise<void> | null
  readonly sockets: IterableIterator<TCPSocket>
  readonly freeSockets: IterableIterator<TCPSocket>
  reuseSocket(socket: TCPSocket, req?: HTTPClientRequest): void
  keepSocketAlive(socket: TCPSocket): boolean
  getName(opts: { host: string; port: number }): string
  addRequest(req: HTTPClientRequest, opts: TCPSocketOptions & TCPSocketConnectOptions): void
  suspend(): void
  resume(): void
  destroy(): void
}
exports.description: An `HTTPAgent` that creates `HTTPSSocket` connections over TLS instead of plain `TCPSocket` connections. Defaults `defaultPort` to `443`.

members.name: createConnection
members.description: Creates a new `HTTPSSocket` connection wrapping a plain TCP connection in TLS.

params.description: Options for the underlying TCP connection and its TLS wrapper.

members.name: HTTPSAgent.global
members.description: The agent's own default instance (created with `keepAlive: 1000` and `timeout: 5000`), used as `bare-https`'s `globalAgent`.
